text: みえない　かべは　よく　みると　しきりが　みえて　くる…！

structure.jp: しきりが　みえて　くる…！

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'when' or 'if' this happens, the next thing follows naturally. よく　みると = 'when you look closely'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: てくる after a verb says a change comes about little by little, moving toward you. みえて　くる = 'start to become visible'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a word describes it. みえない　かべ = 'walls that can't be seen', 'invisible walls'.
